settings.title: Directions for Use
settings.content: Wear on clean skin before stepping outdoors. Pull over face and adjust ear loops for a snug fit. Hand-wash gently in cold water after each use and air-dry away from direct sunlight.

settings.title: Product Specifications
settings.content:
• Material: Ice silk blend (Nylon + Spandex)
  • Coverage: Full face with adjustable ear-loops
  • UV Protection: UPF 50+

settings.heading: Stay Cool & Sweat-Free in the Sun
settings.text: No more sticky, sweaty discomfort. The Ice Silk fabric keeps your face fresh, dry, and comfortable — even in peak heat.

settings.heading: Protect Your Skin from Tanning & UV Damage
settings.text: Step out without worry. This mask shields your face from harsh UV rays, helping prevent tanning, pigmentation, and sun damage.

settings.heading: Full Coverage Without Discomfort
settings.text: Covers your face comfortably without feeling heavy or suffocating — perfect for daily commutes and long hours outdoors.

settings.question: Is this mask suitable for daily use?
settings.answer: Yes — the ice silk fabric is gentle on skin and breathable, designed for everyday wear in any weather.

settings.question: Will it really help prevent tanning?
settings.answer: Yes. The UPF 50+ rating blocks 98% of harmful UV rays. Worn daily, it prevents tanning and pigmentation.

settings.question: Is the mask comfortable for long hours?
settings.answer: Absolutely. The stretchable, lightweight design fits snugly without feeling heavy, even on long commutes.

settings.question: What are the shipping timelines?
settings.answer: We deliver across India in 3–7 working days. Metro cities usually receive orders within 2–4 days.

settings.question: What payment methods are available?
settings.answer: We accept UPI, all major debit/credit cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery. Prepaid orders get an extra 10% off.
